verdict.rationale: cubic supports natural-language interaction via PR comments and chat: users can type commands like '@cubic-dev-ai review this PR', ask chat to 'tour this PR', reply to comments for clarification, request fixes, and connect an MCP server so a coding agent can trigger reviews and manage settings conversationally. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence validating the quality and reliability of these NL interactions, and no evidence of broader free-form command coverage beyond the documented set of trigger phrases.
